nuggets.text: John Harbaugh, the Giants' 21st head coach, beat his brother Jim's 49ers 34-31 in Super Bowl XLVII.
Odell Beckham Jr. is back with the Giants, the team that drafted him 12 years ago.
Odell Beckham Jr.'s famous one-handed touchdown catch came against Dallas on Sunday Night Football in 2014.
Jaxson Dart styles his eye black after Anakin Skywalker's scar because friends said he looked like the Revenge of the Sith character.
Abdul Carter is nicknamed 'Darth Vader' and wears the name on his eye black during games.
Jaxson Dart left Ole Miss as its all-time leader in passing yards, passing Eli Manning.
Jaxson Dart's great-grandfather was U.S. Treasury Secretary David M. Kennedy.
Giants rookie Francis Mauigoa, born in American Samoa, is the younger brother of Jets linebacker Francisco Mauigoa.
The Giants' home, MetLife Stadium, hosted the World Cup final on July 19, when Spain beat Argentina 1-0 in extra time.
Giants offensive coordinator Matt Nagy worked for a home builder and earned a real estate license after his Arena Football days.
